name: Retro Pop
tagline: 70s sunburst, chunky script and springy bounces for promos that feel like a record sleeve.
description: Square, warm and playful style for retail promos, events and announcements. A rotating sunburst, a stack of 70s stripes, an elastic badge that wobbles, and a big bouncing offer.

display.usage: Headlines 150–340px with a hard brown offset shadow

rhythm.notes: Everything overshoots. One big move every ~0.4s, then a pulse on the hero number.

guide:
- 1080×1080. Background is cream #f6e7c8 with a slowly rotating orange sunburst (repeating-conic-gradient, ~55% opacity) and a 4-band stripe stack at the bottom.
- Headlines in Shrikhand with a hard 6–10px #7a3b16 offset text-shadow. No blur, no gradients on text.
- The opener is a big orange circular badge that enters with elastic.out and wobbles ±6°.
- Offers drop in from above with bounce.out, supporting lines pop with back.out(3).
- Exits overshoot too (back.in). Keep it warm: only the five palette colors.
